Singapore, October 12, 2026 – From October 6 to 8, the global crypto industry turned its attention to Singapore for TOKEN2049, a major international industry event. Taking advantage of the gathering, HTX pursued a multifaceted approach encompassing global industry engagement, ecosystem development, and brand awareness. HTX Ventures exhibited at TOKEN2049, where its booth welcomed a steady stream of visitors. HTX DAO hosted “Future Night” and “HTX DAO Reunion,” bringing together industry perspectives and community voices. Meanwhile, a private industry dinner provided an opportunity for invited industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners to connect and exchange views. 

From the public stage of a global summit to in-depth exchanges with ecosystem participants and face-to-face conversations with industry peers, HTX’s presence at TOKEN2049 reflected diverse efforts in industry networking, ecosystem development, and partnership building. Beyond providing opportunities for international industry engagement, these events reflected HTX’s ongoing efforts to strengthen industry connections and foster ecosystem collaboration. 

  1. Taking the Global Crypto Stage: Strong Visitor Interest at the HTX Ventures Booth

As a major annual event for the global crypto industry, TOKEN2049 brings together project teams, investment firms, developers, crypto exchanges, and industry builders from around the world. It serves as an important platform for tracking industry trends, forging business connections, and exploring opportunities for global collaboration.

From October 7-8, HTX Ventures, HTX’s global investment arm, exhibited at TOKEN2049 at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, with its booth located at Level 5, PB5-47 and PB5-48.

Throughout the event, the exhibition floor remained busy, drawing a steady stream of industry participants. The HTX Ventures booth welcomed numerous visitors, offering an engaging, interactive brand experience through brand displays, on-site community activities , and branded merchandise. These activities encouraged visitors to stop by and connect with the team, bringing the HTX brand into face-to-face interactions with members of the global crypto community.

Meanwhile, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX, attended related events and delivered a speech before visiting the HTX Ventures booth to engage with the team and other industry participants, further strengthening HTX’s connections with the global crypto industry.

For the crypto industry, the value of an international summit lies not only in raising brand awareness but also in building meaningful connections with industry participants. By combining booth displays, on-site activities, and industry engagement, HTX Ventures brought the brand closer to the global crypto community, creating more opportunities for connections across the investment ecosystem, project discussions, and potential partnerships.

From steady visitor traffic at its booth to a diverse range of on-site activities, HTX Ventures maintained a strong presence at TOKEN2049, providing HTX with another valuable opportunity to strengthen its connections across the global crypto industry.

  1. From Industry Trends to Ecosystem Development: HTX DAO Advances Community Co-Building

While the TOKEN2049 booth served as HTX’s brand showcase to the global crypto industry, the series of events hosted by HTX DAO took these conversations further, exploring broader topics such as industry trends, community building, and ecosystem development.

On the evening of October 6, HTX DAO hosted the “Future Night” event in Singapore. Molly, an HTX DAO ambassador, shared the latest developments in ecosystem mechanisms, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem. Justin Sun, a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing his perspectives on trends in the crypto industry and the future development of the digital economy.

Sun noted that the crypto industry is deepening its ties with traditional finance, driving the continued digital transformation of global financial infrastructure. AI is changing how wealth is created, while crypto and digital finance are reshaping how wealth is held and transferred.

He further noted that stablecoins could play a greater role in global payments and settlements, while the use of traditional assets such as bonds, funds and gold on-chain will continue to evolve. As AI agents become increasingly involved in economic activity, demand for digital identities, account infrastructure, and the ability to transact autonomously is also likely to grow.

In his view, the long-term value of technology lies in its ability to deliver tangible productivity gains. The free flow of value in the digital world will be a key trend to watch over the next decade.

On ecosystem development, Molly said HTX DAO is exploring potential token utility and ecosystem applications, alongside other initiatives aimed at supporting the development of its ecosystem. For community building, HTX DAO plans to establish regional community hubs in the fourth quarter, enabling members to organize events, exchange ideas, and contribute to the development of the community’s culture. Nearly 200 active volunteers are already contributing to these efforts on their own initiative.

To strengthen its on-chain ecosystem, HTX DAO is engaging university developers from around the world through initiatives such as hackathons. Several projects are currently being explored or developed, including potential applications within the $HTX ecosystem. 

Molly emphasized that ecosystem development requires a long-term commitment. HTX DAO will continue to strengthen its infrastructure, foster an active community, and drive the adoption of ecosystem applications. As an ecosystem participant, HTX continues to gather user feedback and explore improvements to its platform and user experience, with a view to better understanding and responding to evolving user needs. 

From discussions on industry trends to practical initiatives in community development and the on-chain ecosystem, the Future Night event highlighted HTX DAO’s sustained commitment to long-term ecosystem development health  and provided a platform for global community members and industry contributors to connect and collaborate.

III. From Online Communities to In-Person Gatherings: The HTX DAO Reunion Strengthens Ecosystem Connections

Ecosystem growth depends not only on mechanisms and technology, but also on trust among community members and sustained collaboration among participants united by shared goals.

From October 6 to 8, HTX DAO hosted the HTX DAO Reunion, bringing together industry representatives, ecosystem partners, and community members aboard a yacht for face-to-face discussions in an informal setting. 

Unlike traditional conferences built around structured agendas and formal presentations, the event created a more informal setting for participants to exchange views on industry trends, community development, and potential collaborations, fostering a deeper mutual understanding.

For a DAO ecosystem to develop sustainably, community means more than online discussions and on-chain governance. It also depends on meaningful personal connections, ongoing exchanges, and active participation. By creating more diverse opportunities for in-person engagement, HTX DAO is strengthening its ties with community members and partners, opening up new possibilities for community-driven development, ecosystem collaboration, and future partnerships.

From themed discussions to open exchanges, and from online participation to in-person engagement, HTX DAO is exploring diverse approaches to community building and continually strengthening connections among ecosystem participants.

  1. VIP Industry Gathering: Strengthening Face-to-Face Engagement with Ecosystem and Industry Partners

Alongside public engagement with the global industry, HTX also made strengthening relationships with industry peers and partners a priority during Singapore Week.

During the week, HTX hosted a private industry dinner attended by invited industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners. 

Compared with large industry summits, private gatherings provide a more personal setting for direct conversations. These face-to-face interactions allow HTX to listen more closely to partners and exchange views on industry developments, market developments and potential future collaborations.

As the crypto industry evolves, fostering industry relationships requires an understanding of ecosystem developments, effective communication, and the cultivation of long-term partnerships. Face-to-face engagement helps build mutual understanding, laying the groundwork for expanded collaboration across the sector.

From industry discussions at the global summit to in-depth conversations in private settings, HTX is continuously strengthening its relationships with industry partners through engagement at multiple levels.

  1. Driving Long-Term Growth Through Global Engagement: HTX Expands Ecosystem Collaboration

Throughout TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, HTX engaged across multiple fronts, including global industry dialogue, ecosystem development, brand visibility, and industry networking.

HTX Ventures leveraged the international summit to expand its industry network and boost brand engagement through booth activities and in-person interactions. HTX DAO explored industry trends, community building, and the on-chain ecosystem, strengthening connections with community members and developers. Meanwhile, a series of in-person events and private industry gatherings provided further opportunities for HTX to engage with industry peers, ecosystem contributors, and partners. 

While each initiative served a different purpose, they all contributed to the same overarching goal of building broader, deeper, and more enduring industry relationships as the global crypto industry continues to evolve.

For participants in the crypto industry, brand influence stems not only from market visibility but also from sustained engagement in industry development, responsiveness to user needs, and efforts to foster collaboration among communities, projects, and partners.

Looking ahead, HTX intends to continue its engagement with industry participants, ecosystem contributors, and partners, while exploring opportunities for ecosystem collaboration and platform improvements, subject to applicable regulatory requirements. By strengthening connections among global communities, developers, projects, and industry partners, HTX aims to explore new opportunities for the development of digital finance and blockchain ecosystems.

From the global industry stage to the front lines of ecosystem development, HTX will continue to bring industry participants together through open collaboration and drive ecosystem growth through long-term commitment.

title: MEXC Exchange Review: Is It Safe & Legit in 2026?
summary:
MEXC is a global crypto exchange with very low trading fees, more than 3,000 listed digital assets, and high-leverage futures, but it is not licensed or available in every country.
The post MEXC Exchange Review: Is It Safe & Legit in 2026? appeared first on CryptoNinjas.
content:
MEXC is a global crypto exchange with very low trading fees, more than 3,000 listed digital assets, and high-leverage futures, but it is not licensed or available in every country. It serves over 40 million users across more than 170 countries. Still, people in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and several other blocked regions cannot open or use an account.

In this MEXC review, we will cover its fees, supported coins, futures trading, security features, KYC rules, and withdrawal process. You will also learn whether MEXC is safe in your country, who should use it, and which alternatives may suit you better.

What Is MEXC Global Crypto Exchange?

MEXC is a centralized crypto exchange that lets you buy, sell, hold, and trade digital assets from one account. The platform was launched back in 2018 under the name MXC Exchange, then rebranded to MEXC a couple of years later, and it has grown fast ever since.

You get access to spot markets, leveraged futures, savings products, and even a stock-trading arm called RealStocks, all inside one app or website. MEXC mainly built its name around altcoins. It lists new tokens faster than most big-name exchanges.

Now, below is a quick snapshot to give you a first glance at what MEXC actually offers:

Founded2018
Exchange TypeCentralized crypto exchange
User Reach40+ million users; 170+ markets claimed
Supported Coins3,000+ cryptocurrencies
Spot Fees0% maker; 0.05% taker
Futures Fees0% maker; 0.02% taker
Trading FeaturesSpot, futures, trading bots, copy trading, and P2P
Maximum LeverageUp to 200x in eligible regions
Withdrawal LimitsPrimary KYC: 80 BTC; Advanced KYC: 200 BTC daily
Crypto DepositsFree
Fiat OptionsCards, P2P, and third-party providers
Security Tools2FA, passkeys, anti-phishing code, withdrawal whitelist
Restricted RegionsUS, UK, Canada, China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Kazakhstan, and others

What Are the Pros of MEXC?

The pros of MEXC are low trading fees, 3,000+ supported coins, copy trading, built-in bots, advanced futures tools, and published Proof of Reserves.

  • Zero-fee spot maker orders: You pay 0% on maker orders and just 0.05% on taker orders, well below the industry average.
  • Huge coin selection: You can find more than 3,000 crypto coins on MEXC. It has top coins like Bitcoin, but it also has low-cap tokens that you will not find on other platforms.
  • No mandatory KYC for basic use: You can sign up, deposit crypto, and trade spot or futures without submitting ID, at least up to a daily withdrawal limit (limits and no-KYC availability depend on region).
  • Copy trading and bots: The platform includes copy trading, grid bots, and DCA tools built right into the interface.
  • Advanced tools for futures: You get high leverage, hedge mode, cross or isolated margin, trailing stops, demo trading, and bots. Even BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT can reach 200x leverage in some eligible regions.
  • Proof of reserves: MEXC publishes reserve ratios that generally sit well above 100% for major assets like BTC, ETH, and USDT.

What Are the Cons of MEXC?

The cons of MEXC are limited regulatory approval, no direct bank withdrawals in most regions, possible risk-control freezes, third-party fiat services, and thin liquidity on some smaller coins.

  • No license in major markets: MEXC does not have approval from the SEC in the US, the FCA in the UK, or a MiCA license in Europe. Because of these missing licenses, nowadays, the platform completely blocks users from the US, UK, and Canada.
  • No direct bank withdrawal: You cannot send fiat straight to your bank account from MEXC in most regions, so cashing out takes an extra step through P2P or even a second exchange.
  • Risk-control freezes: Actually, some users report accounts getting locked for identity or fund-source review, which can hold up withdrawals for days.
  • Limited fiat on-ramps: Mostly, direct card and bank deposits go through third-party providers like Banxa, MoonPay, and Mercuryo rather than MEXC itself in many regions.
  • Thin liquidity on smaller listings: Some of the newest altcoins carry very thin order books, so a bigger order can easily move the price more than you would expect.

What Are the Fees on MEXC?

MEXC charges basic trading fees of 0% maker and 0.05% taker for spot trading, plus 0% maker and 0.02% taker for futures. Crypto deposits are completely free, while withdrawal fees can easily vary by coin and network, and some trading pairs may have different rates (based on active campaigns).

Spot Trading Fees

MEXC charges 0% in spot maker fees and 0.05% in spot taker fees for standard accounts. A maker order is the one that sits on the order book and waits to get filled, while a taker order is the one that matches instantly against an existing order. MX token holders receive a 20% fee reduction, and discounts apply to eligible spot trades as well.

Futures Trading Fees

MEXC charges a 0% futures maker fee and around 0.02% taker fees for futures trades. This rate can change a little bit based on the contract and where you live, and high volume traders may qualify for better pricing through tiered programs where available in their region. Also, funding rates settle every 8 hours on most pairs, and it usually range between 0.01% and 0.03%, either positive or negative.

Deposit & Withdrawal Fees

You do not have to pay any deposit fee when you add crypto to MEXC, no matter the coin or network. For crypto withdrawals, the fee depends on the specific coin and network you pick, and it goes up or down based on network traffic.

Fiat deposits and fiat purchases usually rely on third-party providers and can vary by region, provider fees, and processing times.

Well, a USDT withdrawal on the Tron network, for example, usually costs (1 USDT fee) far less than the same withdrawal on the Ethereum network (2-5 USDT fee), so picking the right chain easily saves you real money.

Are the Trading Fees on MEXC High?

No, MEXC’s trading fees rank among the lowest in the entire crypto exchange industry. A 0% maker fee on both spot and futures markets beats what Binance, Coinbase, and most other big platforms charge by default. Even the 0.05% spot taker fee and 0.02% futures taker fee sit well under typical industry averages, which often run close to double those numbers. Claims about zero fees mainly refer to maker pricing and occasional exchange promotions, not every trade type.

How to Reduce the MEXC Trading Fees?

You can reduce your MEXC fees in several ways, and the easiest one is simply placing limit orders instead of market orders. Limit orders count as maker orders most of the time, and maker orders cost 0% on both spot and futures. You can also use the MX token to reduce fees by 20% and use our referral code “mexc-bestbonus” to further reduce fees by 10%.

MX Token Fee Discounts

MX is MEXC’s native token, and mx token holders get a direct discount on trading fees. You get a 20% discount on spot and futures fees once the required MX balance is met, and discounts apply automatically with no extra step needed beyond holding the token.

Quick Note: MEXC suspended its older 50% fee discount for holding at least 500 MX. It is temporarily suspended.

MEXC Referral Code

The MEXC referral code “mexc-bestbonus” gives a new eligible user up to a 10% trading-fee discount and access to welcome tasks worth up to 10,000 USDT. You must enter the code while creating the account.

But remember, the full 10,000 USDT is not free cash. Actually, it requires KYC, deposit, and trading-volume tasks, and larger futures rewards usually come as credit you cannot withdraw directly. You can only withdraw profits.

Is MEXC Safe and Legit Globally?

Yes, MEXC is a safe and legit exchange that serves 40 million real traders, but “legit” here does not mean “fully regulated everywhere”. The platform runs real security infrastructure, publishes proof-of-reserves data, and has operated without a major hack since 2018. Still, it holds no top-tier license in the US, the UK, or under the EU’s MiCA framework, so your legal protection depends heavily on where you live.

Basically, MEXC is safe in the technical sense, meaning your funds face reasonable protection from hackers, but it is not “safe” in the regulatory sense the way a bank-backed or fully licensed exchange would be.

Also, there have been complaints about MEXC locking user funds through its risk control system. These freezes are mostly due to abnormal cryptocurrency trading activity in the user’s account.

Regulatory Status

MEXC does not hold any worldwide license that makes every service legal across 170+ markets. In fact, it is a highly unregulated exchange and operates without any license.

Note: MEXC also says it is registered with AUSTRAC in Australia, and in Europe, the exchange uses a local company called MEXC Estonia OÜ to handle some of its legal and compliance work. But again, we could not independently verify these claims, and it seems they are either false or the license is still pending.

Also, the exchange does not have a MiCA license in the EU. The rule deadline was July 1, 2026, so platforms without a license have to get approved or stop taking EU users. Because of this, things are still changing, and we still have to wait and see if people in Europe can use it.

MEXC is currently not available in the US, UK, Canada, Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Iran, North Korea, Cuba, Sudan, Kazakhstan, Russian-controlled parts of Ukraine, and high-risk areas. Plus, hiding your location can lead to account closure and forced liquidation.

So, is MEXC legit? Yes, it is a real exchange. Is it fully regulated globally? No. The difference between those two answers is important.

Available Security Features

MEXC’s available account security features are 2FA, passkeys, anti-phishing code, withdrawal address whitelist, and manual temporary account freeze.

  • Google Authenticator (2FA): You can link Google Authenticator to generate a new six-digit security code every 30 seconds, even without an internet connection. Generally, MEXC uses it as an extra check for sensitive actions such as logging in, trading, and withdrawing crypto.
  • Passkeys: MEXC supports passkeys that easily let you verify yourself using your fingerprint, face recognition, or device PIN instead of entering normal verification codes every time.
  • Anti-Phishing Code: You can create your own anti-phishing code, which MEXC then displays inside genuine emails sent to your account. Hence, it helps you identify fake emails.
  • Withdrawal Address Whitelist: You can turn on a withdrawal whitelist so crypto can only be sent to wallet addresses you have already approved. Also, MEXC even offers a security restriction that places a 24-hour waiting period on newly added whitelist addresses.
  • Account Freeze: MEXC lets you freeze your account quickly when you believe someone else has gained access to it.

Asset Protection

MEXC mainly backs user funds with a $100 million Guardian Fund. This one is built specifically to cover users if the platform ever suffers a hack or major technical failure, and MEXC says it also protects user assets through cold and hot wallet separation. Now, on top of that, the futures side runs its own risk reserve fund, which has held more than half a billion dollars in crypto assets.

MEXC also publishes monthly proof-of-reserves reports, and recent figures show reserve ratios staying pretty healthy, well above 100% for major coins. Hence, this means the exchange holds more crypto in reserve than users technically have on deposit.

What Are the Unique Trading Features of MEXC?

The unique trading features of MEXC are crypto spot trading, high-leverage perpetual futures, stock futures integration, automated bots, and copy trading.

Crypto Spot Trading

MEXC spot trading gives you access to one of the largest selections of cryptocurrencies among major centralized exchanges, with over 3,000 coins and a large range of spot pairs. Here, you can buy the actual crypto using pairs such as BTC/USDT or ETH/USDT, and the purchased coins then appear in your Spot wallet.

You can either place a market order when you want to buy or sell quickly, or use a limit order when you want to choose your own price. MEXC also gives you more order controls than just basic market and limit orders. The spot platform supports TP/SL, OCO, and trailing stop orders.

MEXC pairs its spot market with popular tools like grid bots and dollar-cost averaging, so even a beginner can easily automate a basic buy-low strategy without watching charts all day. The web platform is also easy to access from a browser if you prefer a desktop-style layout.

Crypto Perpetual Futures With High Leverage

MEXC’s futures market lets you trade over 900 perpetual contracts, with leverage reaching up to 200x on BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT pairs. Remember, altcoins have generally lower maximum leverage compared to BTC or ETH.

Currently, the exchange offers USDT-M, USDC-M, and Coin-M futures. USDT-M futures are the easiest to understand because you use USDT as both your margin and settlement currency.

Now, for USDC-M, you will be using USDC as a settlement currency, and for Coin-M, you will be using an underlying currency like BTC or ETH as a settlement currency. MEXC also supports cross margin and isolated margin, along with limit, market, trigger, and other advanced order types.

Stock Futures Integration

MEXC Stock Futures let you trade the price movement of major U.S. stocks directly from its futures platform. You can use crypto such as USDT as margin.

The trading platform currently offers stock futures linked to companies such as Apple, Nvidia, Tesla, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Coinbase, Robinhood, and McDonald’s, along with other available contracts.

Actually, MEXC uses the same general trading interface as its crypto perpetual futures, so the controls will already look familiar to you if you have used MEXC futures before. You can take both long and short positions, and some stock futures contracts even support leverage of up to 200x.

Automated & Copy Trading

MEXC offers many automated trading tools on desktop/browser access and its mobile apps. The main options include Spot Grid, Futures Grid, AI-assisted Futures Grid, and Futures Copy Trading.

Well, grid trading automatically places buy and sell orders inside a price range that you choose. Here, you need to set the upper price, lower price, number of grids, and investment amount, and the bot then tries to buy lower and sell higher as the market moves between those levels.

MEXC also provides futures grid trading, and you can run up to 10 futures grid bots at the same time. The feature currently works with USDT-M futures. Plus, its AI mode can study historical data to suggest the price range, number of grids, and leverage for you. User reviews often praise MEXC’s intuitive interface and easy navigation, while the app is also noted for stable, fast execution.

MEXC’s copy trading tool lets you automatically mirror the trades of experienced traders. You can compare traders using information such as ROI and PNL and then select the futures pairs you want to copy.

What Are MEXC Supported Cryptocurrencies and Trading Markets?

MEXC supports more than 3,000 digital assets along with many new altcoins and memecoins, and several crypto, futures, fiat, and stock-linked markets.

MEXC Supported Cryptocurrencies

MEXC supports major cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, BNB, Cardano, Dogecoin, Tron, and Litecoin. Plus, the stablecoins list includes USDT and USDC, while the wider list shows the exchange supports exposure to both mainstream assets and very new micro-cap projects across DeFi, meme coins, AI tokens, GameFi, Layer 1, Layer 2, DePIN, and real-world assets. Spot trading covers over 3,000 pairs, while the futures side runs more than 900 perpetual contracts. Many of these smaller tokens also appear on MEXC before they become widely accessible on decentralized exchanges.

MEXC Supported Trading Markets

MEXC’s supported markets span more than 170 countries, making it one of the most widely available crypto exchanges anywhere. Now, a specific set of jurisdictions stays fully blocked, though, and that list currently includes the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Singapore, alongside sanctioned states like North Korea, Iran, Cuba, and Sudan, plus several Russian-controlled regions of Ukraine. The European Union sits in a gray zone right now too, since MEXC holds no MiCA license.

How to Open a Trading Account on MEXC Crypto Exchanges

You can open a MEXC account by checking country eligibility, registering with an email or phone number, completing KYC, securing the account, and adding funds.

Step 1. Check your country first: You must not live in or access the exchange from a prohibited region. Plus, using a VPN to hide a blocked location breaks the “User Agreement” and can put withdrawals at risk.

Step 2. Open the official website or app: Visit the MEXC Global ltd official website, enter your email address or phone number, and create a unique password. Add the referral code as well. So, enter “mexc-bestbonus” in the referral field to link the fee discount and eligible new-user tasks. MEXC sends a one-time code to your email or phone. Enter it to finish the basic registration.

Step 3. Complete identity verification: Now, go to the “Identification” section in your account security tab. Select your country and document type, upload a clear ID, and finish the face check if the chosen level asks for it. You must also add security settings like 2FA, phishing codes, etc.

Step 4. Deposit or buy a small amount first: Go to the “Deposit” button under “Assets”, choose the exact coin and network on both platforms. We would suggest using a test transfer before moving a large balance. If supported, you can also deposit fiat currency under the “Buy Crypto” section.

Step 5. Place the first trade: Finally, you can visit the “Trade” section. Spot is the simpler starting point, and futures should wait until you understand margin, funding, liquidation price, and stop-loss orders.

Does MEXC Require KYC?

MEXC may or may not require KYC for trading, depending on your region. You see, MEXC used to be a no-KYC exchange, but nowadays, due to continuous regulatory scrutiny across regions, it has mandatory KYC verification in some countries (we were unable to get the exact list of countries). So, you may expect a KYC message if you are in highly regulated crypto countries.

Now, without KYC verification (wherever supported), MEXC has daily withdrawal limits of 10 BTC every 24 hours. You can increase your limit by completing either Primary or Advanced KYC, as higher limits generally require identity verification and may vary by region. Primary KYC allows withdrawals of up to 80 BTC within 24 hours, while Advanced KYC increases this limit to 200 BTC and includes additional features like OTC trading.

What Documents Are Required for KYC?

MEXC’s Primary KYC tier asks for a government-issued ID, like a passport, national ID card, or driver’s license.

Advanced KYC adds a proof of address requirement on top of that, usually a recent utility bill, bank statement, or official government letter dated within the last three months. Plus a live selfie to match your face against the document.

Also, institutional accounts need company registration paperwork and board-level documentation instead of personal ID. Every photo needs to be clear and unedited, since blurry or altered images are a common reason verification gets delayed or rejected.

How Long Does MEXC Verification Take?

MEXC verification normally finishes within about 15 minutes, but a review can take 8 to 24 hours. Actually, a busy market period, blurry image, data mismatch, unsupported document, or failed face scan can even make it slower.

Can You Withdraw Money From MEXC?

Yes, you can withdraw money from MEXC, though the process works a bit differently than a typical bank-linked exchange. If a withdrawal issue comes up, MEXC offers 24/7 customer support through live chat and email. You see, MEXC does not support direct fiat withdrawals to a bank account in most regions, so you need to either use the built-in P2P marketplace or move your crypto to a second exchange that does support bank withdrawals.

Now, through P2P, you must sell your crypto directly to another user who pays you through bank transfer, and MEXC holds the funds in escrow until both sides confirm the trade went through. The alternative route sends your crypto, usually a stablecoin like USDT, to an exchange such as Binance, Kraken, or Coinbase, where you sell it and then withdraw the cash straight to your bank. Some users also report delayed withdrawals, especially when compliance checks or P2P disputes are involved. Fiat support remains limited, and the exchange supports cash-out mainly through P2P or transfers to another platform rather than direct bank rails in most regions.

What Are the Alternatives to MEXC?

The best MEXC alternatives are Binance, Bybit, Coinbase, and Kraken. Here is a quick comparison:

ExchangeSupported CoinsBase Spot Fees (Maker/Taker)Futures TradingLicensed?Best Alternative in MEXC-Restricted Regions
MEXC3,000+0% / 0.05%Yes, up to 200xNo–
Bybit1,200+0.10% / 0.10%Yes, up to 125xYes, through regional entitiesEurope
Binance600+0.10% / 0.10%Yes, up to 125xYes, through regional entitiesAsia (Japan, India)
Coinbase240+0.40% / 0.60% at the starting tierYes, up to 50x in eligible international marketsYes, including the US, UK, Canada, and EUUS, UK, Canada, and Singapore
Kraken350+0.40% / 0.80% at the starting tierYes, up to 50x in eligible non-US marketsYes, with 100+ licenses and registrations across 30+ countriesUS, UK, and Canada

Who Should Use MEXC?

You should use MEXC if you want access to a large altcoin selection, low trading fees, high-leverage futures, copy trading, built-in trading bots, and other unique features.

  • Altcoin traders: MEXC is really a good fit for you if you mainly look for early access to smaller or newer cryptocurrencies. As discussed earlier, the exchange lists thousands of spot trading pairs, so you get more choice than on many larger regulated platforms.
  • Futures traders: You can prefer MEXC if you actively trade perpetual futures and want access to high leverage. Well, some selected BTC and ETH contracts can offer leverage of up to 200x.
  • Active traders looking for low fees: MEXC can work well if you trade frequently and want to keep trading costs very low. Its standard spot and futures fees are very low compared to other exchanges like Binance or Bitget, and some spot campaigns offer zero fees on eligible pairs.
  • Traders who use bots or copy trading: MEXC is useful if you want to automate part of your trading instead of placing every order yourself. You can use grid bots, AI-assisted futures grid tools, and copy trading from the same account.
  • Professional traders who want more market choices: MEXC suits experienced traders who want access to spot, futures, stock futures, and advanced order types in one place, and it can also appeal if you want extras like a token issuance platform and occasional token sales alongside the main exchange. Basically, you get a lot of advanced tools, but the platform can feel a bit much for someone completely new to crypto.

Now, who should avoid MEXC? Mainly, beginners who want strong consumer protections, direct bank withdrawals, and a fully regulated home base in the US or UK, though, should probably look elsewhere, since MEXC simply is not built for that kind of user; beginners looking for demo accounts that mirror live markets may also prefer a more education-first setup.

title: DATA Network joins Sui and Walrus to scale the supply chain for AI training data
summary: Palo Alto, United States, 12th October 2026, Chainwire
content:
Skip to content

Palo Alto, United States, 12th October 2026, Chainwire

Palo Alto, United States, October 12th, 2026, Chainwire

Trace, the onchain registry for rights-cleared AI training data with more than 250 million verifiable receipts, brings its training data to Sui and Walrus to power the next generation of AI models.

Sui Foundation and The DATA Foundation today announced that the DATA Network and its Trace registry are joining the Sui stack, bringing a live supply of rights-cleared AI training data onto the infrastructure Sui has built for AI workloads. Walrus, the data platform with integrity proofs anchored on Sui, becomes the default storage layer for applications operated by DATA Foundation. Separately, the DATA Network will be upgraded to run as a protocol natively on Sui.

The upgrade gives AI labs a single place to source real-world training data they are allowed to use, with its provenance recorded by Trace and the original file stored and access-controlled on Walrus.

The data AI needs next

The next generation of AI models is constrained by access to real-world data. The open internet has been scraped, and the data that comes next must be sourced from people, with consent and with provenance that regulators and legal teams will accept. The EU AI Act and ongoing litigation over training data have made provenance a procurement requirement for labs.

The data those models need sits with people rather than on the open web: a nurse describing a patient’s night in her own words, a dashcam recording of a rainy commute in Jakarta, a factory technician’s hands as they diagnose a fault, or a customer call conducted in Bengali. It is personal and often regulated, and it belongs to the people who generated it.

Trace, launched by DATA Foundation in June as an onchain registry for AI training data, was built for exactly this kind of data. It records the origin of each contribution and the rights attached to it, and settles payment to the person who contributed it. It has registered more than 250 million contributions since launch and now processes over 3M receipts per day on average. Applications writing to Trace include Kled, the largest opt-in human data marketplace with over 1.5 billion records being onboarded, along with Numo and Oto, applications that already license data to frontier AI labs and robotics companies.

Why Sui and Walrus

Sui represents every asset as a programmable object, allowing datasets and their licenses to be managed onchain like tokens. Independent transactions execute in parallel and settle in under a second, making the network capable of handling millions of daily registrations. Walrus extends this capability to large files: it stores massive AI datasets efficiently and ensures data is only readable by licensed buyers. No other network offers storage, access control, and ownership tracking built natively into a single ecosystem, together with verifiable compute.

Trace now adds a flagship supply of rights-cleared data, with existing demand from the AI labs that license it today. The result of the integration will be stronger provenance guarantees and tamper evidence. Today a Trace record proves that a file was registered and when, and with Walrus, Trace will be able to hold an encrypted, immutable copy of the contributed file itself as a reference guarantee. The hash of the record can be regenerated from the data itself rather than from metadata an application supplied, and any later processing of the file can be checked against the original.

The upgrade is backed by a long-term strategic investment. Sui Foundation is investing $30 million in the DATA Network, establishing the largest institutional stake in the network, alongside the continuing holdings of PIP Labs and the DATA Foundation. Furthering the alignment, SY Lee, Chairman of Poseidon and CEO of PIP Labs, joins Sui Foundation as Strategic Advisor.

The protocol upgrade

DATA Network will be upgraded to run as a protocol natively on Sui, and its independent chain will be retired. $DATA continues as the token of the DATA protocol on Sui, carried over one-to-one, with holder economics and governance rights at least equivalent to today. Locked and vesting positions carry over unchanged. In parallel, Walrus becomes the default storage layer for DATA Foundation applications.

Adeniyi Abiodun, Co-Founder and Chief Product Officer at Mysten Labs, the original contributor to Sui and Walrus, said: “The AI industry has reached the point where the open internet has been read, and the next frontier is defined by access to datasets with the consent and provenance that regulators require. Sui and Walrus were built to be the home where AI data is stored, licensed, and paid for, capable of operating at the scale these systems demand. The migration of DATA Network and Trace to our stack now brings massive volumes of high-quality, rights-cleared data that is already serving the world’s frontier AI labs.”

SY Lee, Chairman of Poseidon and CEO of PIP Labs, said: “The next generation of AI will be trained on data that lives with people rather than on the open web, and that data needs consent and provenance built in, along with a way to pay the people it comes from, and Trace was built to be that layer. It now becomes part of the Sui stack alongside Walrus, backed by one of the strongest engineering organizations in the industry and with Sui Foundation as the network’s largest strategic holder. This is the right home for the network we built, and I am looking forward to helping Sui make it the data layer for AI.”

Andrea Muttoni, CEO of DATA Foundation, said: “Training data is critical for continuously expanding the frontier, and making sure it is traceable, auditable and cleared to use is just as important for AI safety as it is a precursor for data quality. With Trace, we have been tracking hundreds of millions of data assets. Joining forces with Sui now allows us to build out more of the stack, offering more than just an audit trail, like encrypted reference file storage and potentially fully verifiable TEEs for evals and fine tunings in the future.”

The existing DATA Network will continue to operate until the upgrade is complete, and a detailed timeline and holder transition plan will be published prior to the upgrade.

About DATA Foundation

DATA Foundation supports the DATA Network, the protocol for tracking provenance of the real-world data AI models need. Through Trace, each contribution is registered with its provenance receipt and a full audit trail. Applications building on the network include Kled, Numo, Oto, and others. Formerly Story Foundation, the organization refocused on AI training data in June 2026. The DATA Network is being upgraded to run as a protocol on Sui.

About Sui

Sui, where money moves as freely as messages, is a next-generation Layer 1 blockchain built for onchain finance and agentic infrastructure. Founded by the core team behind Meta’s stablecoin initiative and powered by an object-centric model, Sui makes assets, permissions, and user data programmable and verifiable. Sui’s primitives offer everything necessary to create high-performance finance and AI-native applications. Learn more at sui.io.

About Walrus

Walrus is the data platform built for the demands of AI. It lets builders, enterprises, and AI agents move data across apps and models, protect it with built-in access rules, and make it verifiable by anyone. As AI takes actions with consequence, the data it runs on has to be provable. Created by the cryptographers and distributed systems engineers behind Sui and Meta’s first stablecoin initiative. walrus.xyz

title: Keeper – Why Tonkeeper Went Multichain
summary: Nikita Monastyrskiy is chief marketing officer at Keeper, the self-custodial wallet formerly known as Tonkeeper. He started in crypto in 2018, running bounty and Bitcointalk signature campaigns while still at university, then spent four years at a crypto marketing agency, rising from community manag...
content:
Skip to content

Nikita Monastyrskiy is chief marketing officer at Keeper, the self-custodial wallet formerly known as Tonkeeper. He started in crypto in 2018, running bounty and Bitcointalk signature campaigns while still at university, then spent four years at a crypto marketing agency, rising from community manager to senior growth strategist. He went on to join the marketing team at Ethereum layer two Mode, helping take it from launch to exchange listings, before moving to Wallet in Telegram in 2025 as head of partner marketing. He later switched from the custodial side to the self-custodial one, joining Tonkeeper to lead its marketing.

The link will open a new window. Click the menu and down arrow to download the file.

Why you should listen

Tonkeeper built its reputation as the leading wallet on TON, and last month it gave up the name. Monastyrskiy explains why: users had stopped living on a single chain, and were juggling several apps to hold stablecoins on TRON, Bitcoin, Ethereum and assets on layer twos. The “TON” in the name tied the brand to one network, so the team dropped it and kept the rest. Keeper now supports seven networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, TRON and Base, and launched mobile-first, because that is where the data showed younger users transacting. 

He is direct about the trade-off at the heart of self-custody. Keeper cannot access, freeze or recover user funds, and he argues that the risk people associate with self-custody comes down to how they store their recovery phrase. Keep it offline and secure, and the main danger disappears. The harder part, in his view, is psychological: when an exchange gets hacked, users have someone to blame, but with self-custody the responsibility is entirely theirs. He sees the wallet as stage one of crypto adoption, the place where someone buys their first Bitcoin, and stage two as giving those users access to everything else on-chain, from tokenized stocks and prediction markets to simpler perpetual futures trading, which he says remains too complicated for newcomers.

Looking further out, Monastyrskiy describes his ideal wallet as one users barely see: connected to an AI assistant, taking voice commands to swap or trade, with no thought given to gas or withdrawals. He thinks a supervised version, where users still sign each transaction, is about a year away, and full automation further off. He also reports a pickup in on-chain activity since May, with volumes rising again this quarter. In the hot take round, he argues that real adoption will come from everyday payments in emerging markets rather than institutions, and picks Nineteen Eighty-Four as the science fiction he fears could become reality.

title: Evernorth XRP Treasury Merger Brings 473 Million XRP to Nasdaq as XRPN Debuts October 12
summary: Evernorth has completed its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, bringing 473 million XRP and $300 million in gross cash to its upcoming Nasdaq debut under ticker XRPN on October 12, 2026.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XRP

Evernorth has completed its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II, bringing 473 million XRP and $300 million in gross cash to its upcoming Nasdaq debut under ticker XRPN on October 12, 2026.

The transaction gives public-market investors another route to gain exposure to XRP through a company that actively manages its digital asset holdings. Backed by institutional investors including Ripple, Pantera Capital, Kraken, SBI Group, and Arrington Capital, Evernorth plans to allocate capital to XRP ecosystem infrastructure, decentralized finance (DeFi) strategies, and other initiatives intended to expand the token’s utility.

Evernorth Completes SPAC Merger With Armada Acquisition Corp. II

Evernorth announced the completion of its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II on October 9, marking its transition into the public markets. Armada, a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC), was sponsored by Arrington XRP Capital Fund, LP.

Evernorth completed its SPAC merger with Arrington XRP Capital-sponsored Armada Acquisition Corp. II, with Nasdaq trading under the ticker $XRPN scheduled to begin on October 12, 2026. Source: @evernorthxrp via X

Under the announced schedule, Evernorth common stock will begin trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market on October 12 under the ticker XRPN. The company also expects to participate in Nasdaq’s closing-bell ceremony on October 14, bringing together executives, investors, and members of the XRP ecosystem.

The merger establishes a publicly traded vehicle focused on managing an XRP treasury rather than simply holding the token as a passive reserve. Evernorth intends to combine digital asset exposure with the reporting, disclosure, and governance requirements associated with a Nasdaq-listed company.

Evernorth Enters Nasdaq With 473 Million XRP and $300 Million in Cash

At the close of the transaction, Evernorth held approximately 473 million XRP and raised around $300 million in gross cash proceeds before transaction expenses. The company said its investors include Arrington Capital, Ripple, Pantera Capital, Kraken, SBI Group, and GSR.

Evernorth will launch with approximately 473 million XRP and $300 million in cash, backed by major crypto investors and led by former Ripple executive Asheesh Birla. Source: @TheCryptoSquire via X

The combination of XRP holdings and cash gives Evernorth capital to manage its treasury and pursue investments across the broader XRP economy. However, the $300 million figure represents gross proceeds, not cash remaining after transaction costs or subsequent spending.

Evernorth is positioning itself as an institutional investment vehicle for people and organizations seeking XRP exposure through public equity markets. Investors buying XRPN shares will own stock in the company, not XRP directly. As a result, the share price may not move in exact proportion to XRP’s market price.

The company’s performance will also depend on its treasury management decisions, operating expenses, capital allocation, and ability to execute its business strategy.

Asheesh Birla Outlines Evernorth’s XRP Treasury Strategy

Evernorth CEO and founder Asheesh Birla said the company was established to support the XRP ecosystem while maintaining the transparency expected of a publicly traded business.

“In setting out to build Evernorth, our goal was to create something unique: an actively managed XRP treasury purpose-built to support the growth of the ecosystem with the transparency and governance that public markets demand,” Birla said in the October 9 announcement.

Evernorth CEO Asheesh Birla outlined a vision of tech-driven finance built on autonomous digital money and blockchain infrastructure as the company prepares to list on Nasdaq under $XRPN. Source: Asheesh Birla via X

The company intends to deploy capital across infrastructure, financial applications, and use cases designed to increase XRP’s utility. Its strategy also includes institutional and DeFi yield opportunities, ecosystem participation, and capital markets activities.

Evernorth has stated that it aims to grow the amount of XRP represented by each share over time. Achieving that objective will depend on investment returns, treasury management costs, changes in the company’s share count, and the performance of its holdings. The target is a stated business objective, not a guaranteed outcome.

Institutional Backing Supports Evernorth’s Public-Market Plans

Evernorth’s investor base includes several established participants in the digital asset industry. Ripple, Pantera Capital, Kraken, SBI Group, Arrington Capital, and GSR are among the institutions identified in the company’s announcement.

Michael Arrington, founder of Arrington Capital, said the firm’s support reflects its view that the XRP ecosystem can attract additional capital as it develops.

“Our conviction in XRP has always been rooted in the belief that the ecosystem would continue to mature, attracting serious builders and capital,” Arrington said.

Evernorth plans to direct capital toward areas such as tokenized assets, on-chain credit markets, and settlement infrastructure. These sectors require funding to develop products and expand their operations, although their commercial prospects and adoption rates remain uncertain.

Its public listing may make the company more accessible to investors who prefer traditional brokerage accounts over direct cryptocurrency ownership. However, stock market access does not eliminate the risks associated with digital assets, and investors will still face company-specific and market-related uncertainties.

What XRPN’s Nasdaq Listing Means for XRP Investors

Evernorth’s arrival on Nasdaq creates another publicly traded option for investors seeking exposure to the XRP ecosystem. Instead of purchasing and managing XRP themselves, investors can buy shares in a company whose treasury and strategy are closely tied to the token.

The distinction matters because XRPN shares and XRP are separate assets. The stock’s valuation will reflect not only the market value of Evernorth’s XRP holdings but also its cash position, liabilities, operating costs, investment results, and investors’ assessment of its future prospects.

XRP price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

Evernorth’s strategy also introduces execution risks. DeFi activities can involve smart-contract vulnerabilities, liquidity constraints, and counterparty exposure. In addition, XRP price volatility could affect the value of its treasury and, in turn, investor sentiment toward its shares.

The company has cautioned that its business plans are subject to regulatory changes, market conditions, competition, and the risks of maintaining a public listing. Its future performance will depend on how effectively management navigates these challenges while pursuing its stated treasury objectives.

Evernorth expects to mark its public-market debut with a Nasdaq closing-bell ceremony on October 14, two days after the scheduled start of trading. The listing will put its active XRP treasury strategy under public-market scrutiny as investors assess whether the company can translate its substantial holdings and institutional backing into sustainable long-term value.

Learn2Trade also provides real-time alerts on technical analysis updates and market events. Members can attend webinars to explore market trends in depth. The group sends signals through Telegram and email. It has a free group with two channels, one for news and one for crypto. VIP signals are received through a private bot (L2TAlgo). Learn2Trade also integrates with regulated brokers such as eToro and Eightcap.

The VIP group takes it to the next level with 3 to 5 daily signals. Every signal has the crypto pair (such as BTC/USD), entry point, stop-loss, take-profit levels, and risk-reward ratio. They even recommend how much to trade, which helps keep risk in check.

Cons of Learn2Trade:

7. Wallstreet Queen Official

Wallstreet Queen Official is a large Telegram channel specializing in crypto signals and trading advice. It has more than 145,000 subscribers, placing it among the biggest groups of its nature. The channel is operated by a female who goes by the “Wallstreet Queen” moniker, who states she has several years of experience trading on Wall Street before venturing into crypto. She founded the community in 2021 with a vision to assist traders, particularly women, to thrive in the world of cryptocurrency.

The channel provides both free and paid services. Free members receive 1-2 daily signals and simple market news and updates. The signals contain entry points, stop-loss, and target prices for widely traded cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum. The group boasts a signal accuracy rate is moderately high, this emphasizes fewer quality trades instead of bombarding members with endless signals.

The channel claims to cover a broad spectrum of cryptocurrencies, not only the well-known ones, providing traders with varied choices. Learning is a major aspect of their activity. Members get marked-up charts describing why a trade is suggested, such as support and resistance levels. The channel also offers frequent market analyses, such as news on Bitcoin’s price action or crypto adoption. Risk management is pushed, and oftentimes, members are told to be patient and let dips come.

Pricing of Wallstreet Queen Official:

Wallstrenn Queen Official premium membership is $150 monthly, $300 for three months and $1,000 for a lifetime of access. Premium members receive all the signals – typically 2-3 per day – along with extended technical analysis, market trend reviews, and price forecasts. Users also receive access to special “pump” events where the community coordinates trades to pump up individual coins.

Pros of Wallstreet Queen Official:

  • Over 145,000 subscribers show huge popularity
  • The group claimed moderately high signal accuracy
  • The free tier offers 1-2 daily signals
  • Premium channel gives 2-3 signals daily with detailed technical analysis

Cons of Wallstreet Queen Official:

  • Don’t guarantee free signal frequency
  • Pump events are very risky and often result in losses

Wolf of Trading is a highly popular Telegram group that offers crypto trading signals and market analysis. The group has grown rapidly and now has over 60,000 subscribers. Individuals are attracted to it due to its combination of free and paid services, strong focus on real-time updates, and thorough technical analysis.

The channel provides 2 to 3 free signals per week. Each signal has concise details such as entry price, stop-loss, and several take-profit targets. The free signals primarily target Bitcoin and Ethereum but occasionally include top altcoins as well. The team generates these signals using technical analysis and predictive models.

They also provide marked-up charts with all their signals so members can see the rationale for every trade. Fear and greed index updates daily to provide additional information regarding market sentiment. Members indicate that the VIP signals are moderate accurate. Generally, the group also avoids long-term investment recommendations.

The channel began years back in London and has a strong reputation for honesty. They do not hide losses and frequently outline what went wrong when a trade fails. Such honesty, coupled with their clear signals, has people returning repeatedly.

Pricing of Wolf of Trading:

Wolf of Trading offers a VIP subscription. The paid service provides 2 to 4 daily signals, short-term market updates, and access to the Trading Academy. The VIP membership costs about $99 per month or $999 per year.

Pros of Wolf of Trading:

  • Offers 2-3 free signals weekly with clear details
  • VIP channel gives 2-4 daily signals with moderate accuracy
  • Trading Academy teaches strategies for beginners
  • Over 60,000 Telegram subscribers, a big community
  • Shares daily fear and greed index updates

Cons of Wolf of Trading:

  • Limited long-term investment signals and insights
  • Limited free signals for new users

9. Fat Pig Signals

Fat Pig Signals is a popular Telegram channel offering crypto trading signals. It began in 2016 and became a big name by 2017 when it created a YouTube channel for market analysis. title: BNB Price Prediction: Double Bottom or Rising Wedge Breakdown? BNB Faces a Crucial $730 Test
summary: BNB is approaching a key support zone near $730 as weakening momentum and competing chart patterns leave its short-term outlook uncertain.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: BNB

BNB is approaching a key support zone near $730 as weakening momentum and competing chart patterns leave its short-term outlook uncertain.

 A potential double bottom could support a BNB price recovery toward $800, while a breakdown below the rising wedge structure may expose lower support levels between $700 and $680.

Recent technical setups highlight the importance of the $725–$730 area. A sustained hold could give buyers another opportunity to challenge resistance, but continued selling pressure may extend the correction. Traders are watching whether BNB can establish a base or confirm a deeper pullback.

BNB Price Forecast: $730 Support Puts Bulls and Bears at a Crossroads

BNB has been trading around $740–$751, following repeated rejection near the $800–$810 resistance zone. The price has also slipped below a four-hour rising channel and the daily chart’s 0.236 Fibonacci retracement near $746, according to Cryptorphic’s analysis.

BNB has broken below its 4-hour rising channel support, trading near $743 as short-term bearish momentum intensifies. Source: Cryptorphic via X

These developments indicate that short-term momentum has weakened. The loss of the rising channel’s lower boundary suggests buyers have struggled to maintain the previous upward structure. Meanwhile, the break below the Fibonacci level has placed additional attention on nearby support zones.

Cryptorphic previously maintained a bullish outlook while BNB held above $760 and the rising channel remained intact. The latest assessment takes a more cautious position, identifying further downside risk unless the broken technical levels are reclaimed.

The next support levels highlighted in that analysis stand near $719, $706, and $674. These are potential areas where buyers could attempt to stabilize the price, rather than guaranteed reversal points. A sustained recovery above $746 and the former channel support would help ease the immediate bearish pressure.

BNB Double Bottom Pattern Signals a Possible Recovery Toward $800

Despite the recent weakness, a separate four-hour chart setup identified by crypto analyst @gandreou007 points to a possible double bottom, commonly referred to as a W pattern. The formation could develop if BNB revisits the $727–$733 area, stabilizes, and establishes a second base near its earlier low.

BNB could form a 4-hour double bottom near $727–$733, with a breakout above $754–$756 potentially opening a recovery toward $800; a drop below $714 would invalidate the setup. Source: @gandreou007 via X

A double bottom typically features two troughs around a similar price level, separated by a recovery. However, two tests of support alone do not confirm the pattern. Buyers must push the price through resistance separating the two lows to establish a stronger bullish case.

In this setup, the $754–$756 region is the key confirmation zone. A break above that range followed by a successful retest would strengthen the recovery scenario and suggest that buyers are regaining control of the short-term trend.

The initial upside area sits around $775–$780, followed by $800. A move from $730 to $800 would represent an increase of approximately 9.6%, although reaching that target would depend on continued buying pressure and the ability to overcome intermediate resistance.

The setup also has a clear invalidation level. A decline below $714 would undermine the proposed double-bottom structure and weaken the case for a recovery toward $800. Until BNB clears the confirmation zone, the pattern remains a possibility rather than an established reversal.

BNB Rising Wedge Breakdown Puts $700–$680 Support in Focus

A separate analysis published by crypto_vulture_signals on TradingView identifies a rising wedge on BNB’s daily chart. The pattern features higher lows within converging trendlines, while weakening momentum raises questions about whether the upward structure can continue.

Rising wedges can precede bearish breakouts, particularly when price repeatedly fails to clear overhead resistance. In BNB’s case, the $800–$810 region has repeatedly capped advances, suggesting that buyers have struggled to sustain upward momentum at higher prices.

BNB is trading near $740 after repeated rejection at $800–810, while a daily rising wedge and weakening momentum raise the risk of a bearish breakdown. Source: crypto_vulture_signals on TradingView

The immediate support area lies between $725 and $730, broadly matching the level monitored in the potential double-bottom setup. This overlap makes the zone especially important: a successful defense could support a short-term rebound, while a decisive breakdown would weaken both the broader chart structure and the bullish reversal case.

According to the TradingView analysis, a confirmed daily close below $725 could open the way toward the $700–$680 region. That move would extend the correction from current levels and indicate that sellers have gained further control.

The bearish wedge scenario would be challenged by a sustained breakout above $810. Such a move would indicate that buyers had overcome the resistance zone that has repeatedly limited BNB’s recovery attempts. Until then, the combination of weakening momentum and failed advances supports a cautious outlook.

Key BNB Price Levels to Watch

BNB’s next move will depend on how the price reacts to nearby support and whether buyers can reclaim the resistance levels lost during the recent decline.

  • $800–$810 resistance: A major overhead barrier. A sustained breakout above $810 would weaken the bearish rising-wedge thesis.
  • $775–$780 resistance: The first recovery target in the double-bottom scenario and a potential test of renewed buying strength.
  • $754–$756 resistance: The immediate confirmation area for the proposed four-hour double bottom.
  • $746 resistance: The daily Fibonacci retracement level that BNB has fallen below. Reclaiming it would help improve the short-term outlook.
  • $725–$730 support: The central level for both competing setups. Holding this zone could support consolidation or a rebound.
  • $719 and $706 support: Potential downside levels identified in Cryptorphic’s analysis if selling continues.
  • $700–$680 support: The lower target zone in the rising-wedge breakdown scenario, with $674 identified as an additional support level in the separate daily-chart analysis.
  • $714 invalidation level: A break below this level would weaken the specific double-bottom setup described by @gandreou007.

These levels come from separate technical analyses and should not be treated as a single confirmed trading signal. The difference between a temporary move below support and a sustained breakdown will depend on the closing price, follow-through, and subsequent retest.

BNB Price Outlook: Will BNB Rebound or Extend Its Correction?

BNB faces two competing technical possibilities near $730. The double-bottom scenario offers a potential path toward $775–$780 and eventually $800, but it requires a break above $754–$756 and a successful retest. Without that confirmation, the bullish pattern remains incomplete.

BNB price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The bearish case gains strength if BNB fails to hold $725–$730 and records a confirmed daily close below the zone. That development could bring $700–$680 into focus, while the additional support levels at $719, $706, and $674 provide reference points from the separate Fibonacci and channel analysis.

For now, the price remains caught between weakening short-term momentum and the possibility of a support-driven rebound. Reclaiming $746 and then $754–$756 would improve the bullish outlook, whereas a sustained break below $725 would shift attention toward lower support.

The $730 area is therefore a key decision zone, not a guaranteed turning point. Confirmation from price action will be essential to determine whether BNB is building a second base or continuing its correction.

title: Brazil’s BRL 22T CSD BR Moves Fund Records to XRP Ledger in Live Tokenization Push
summary:
Key Takeaways: CSD BR is leveraging the XRP Ledger to reflect real-time fund holdings. Over BRL 22 trillion in registered assets is managed by the infrastructure. Future stages could include
The post Brazil’s BRL 22T CSD BR Moves Fund Records to XRP Ledger in Live Tokenization Push appeared first on...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • CSD BR is leveraging the XRP Ledger to reflect real-time fund holdings.
  • Over BRL 22 trillion in registered assets is managed by the infrastructure.
  • Future stages could include natively issuing and trading tokenized securities.

Ripple and CSD BR are focusing on ushering blockchain tokenization into the financial market by making financial-market records available in real time.

The first phase involves investment funds for the BTG Pactual shares and the existing systems in CSD BR are the official platform for registration, deposit, settlement.

  • CSD BR Adds XRP Ledger to BRL 22T Infrastructure
  • Fund Shares Will Be Mirrored, Not Replaced
    • Ripple and CSD BR Move Beyond Blockchain Pilots
    • Tokenized CRI and CRA Assets Could Come Next

CSD BR Adds XRP Ledger to BRL 22T Infrastructure

The XRP Ledger will be an extra layer for a financial-market infrastructure provider in Brazil, CSD BR, to register and audit financial assets. The company has an asset balance of over BRL 22 trillion, and can carry out millions of transactions in minutes.

Selected BTG Pactual fund shares staked with CSD BR will be mapped in XRPL via the Multi-Purpose Token (MPT) standard.

The blockchain record will not be considered a replacement for the CSD BR’s official database. Rather, authorized participants will be able to check the accuracy of the blockchain data against the current system and verify record consistency in real time.

Read More: Ripple Says $XRP, RLUSD Could Turn 24/7 Crypto Into a CFO Treasury Tool

Fund Shares Will Be Mirrored, Not Replaced

The project will help them to keep the existing laws unchanged and conduct trials in the market environment.

CSD BR will keep full control over asset issuance and administration. It will also maintain systems for qualification and freezing assets and executing asset reversals as needed in response to regulators or courts.

In Brazil access will be permissioned and restricted to a group of qualified corporate and banking customers with Know Your Customer and anti-money laundering compliance criteria.

Ripple’s custody infrastructure will work alongside XRPL’s native tokenization features to support the system.

Read More: Ripple Shifts to Digital Assets Custody

Ripple and CSD BR Move Beyond Blockchain Pilots

The project will be the first time blockchain is used in active financial systems, rather than in proofs of concept testing. To test transparency, traceability and automation, without impacting investors or issuers’ processes, CSD BR said it selected the record-mirroring model.

The project also complies with the current regulatory framework in Brazil and it will not require any new licenses for its first phase. The deployment for Ripple elevates the value proposition of XRPL beyond only crypto-native transactions into a place of regulatory infrastructure.

Tokenized CRI and CRA Assets Could Come Next

The first stage will be a success with CSD BR and Ripple will delve into native issuance and trading directly on the XRP Ledger.

In the case of Brazil’s fixed-income market, two key asset categories are being assessed – Real Estate Receivables Certificates (CRI) and Agribusiness Receivables Certificates (CRA). Further development work is also planned, with better confidentiality capabilities for users at institutional level.

It has been designed to accommodate more asset classes, other participants, and potentially, international expansion, in the future.

For now, the BRL 22 trillion figure represents the scale of CSD BR’s existing registered-asset infrastructure, not the amount being tokenized on XRPL. The current rollout starts with selected BTG Pactual fund shares and a live blockchain-based audit layer.

summary: Geneva, Switzerland, October 10, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), participated in TOKEN2049 Singapore as Title Sponsor and in Blockworks’ Digital Asset Summ...

Geneva, Switzerland, October 10, 2026 — TRON DAO, the community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet through blockchain technology and decentralized applications (dApps), participated in TOKEN2049 Singapore as Title Sponsor and in Blockworks’ Digital Asset Summit (DAS) Asia 2026 at the Marina Bay Sands. TRON Founder Justin Sun joined fireside discussions at both conferences, sharing his views on stablecoins, institutional adoption, AI-driven commerce, machine-to-machine payments and the need for quantum-resilient blockchain infrastructure.

On October 7, Sun joined Michael Ippolito, Co-Founder of Blockworks, on the main stage at DAS Asia 2026 for a fireside titled “In Conversation with Justin Sun.” Organized by Blockworks, DAS Asia is an institution-focused digital asset conference examining the intersection of traditional finance and the digital asset economy. The conversation covered the evolution of stablecoins, institutional adoption, agentic AI payments and TRON’s role in the global digital asset economy.

Sun highlighted the growing role of tokenized assets and stablecoins as practical financial infrastructure, particularly for cross-border payments and access to digital dollars and U.S.-based assets. He also discussed the emerging role of AI agents in the economy, predicting that within the near future, AI agents will increasingly make payments, purchase digital services and manage financial activity on behalf of users.

On October 8, Sun joined Kevin Follonier, Founder of When Shift Happens, for “Fireside Chat with Justin Sun” on the TOKEN2049 main stage. The discussion explored the future of blockchain, stablecoins, AI agents and the broader evolution of global finance. Sun also discussed the need to prepare blockchain networks for quantum computing, noting that TRON has already made meaningful progress toward post-quantum readiness, with end-to-end post-quantum signature support deployed on the Nile testnet.

Furthermore, pointing to the mathematics behind the cryptography that secures blockchain networks, Sun turned to the Justin Sun Prize, which he describes as the “Nobel Prize of the AI Era.” Structured as a zero-trust, decentralized academic bounty mechanism built around a “problem list,” the prize recognizes breakthroughs in fundamental disciplines verified through machine formal verification. It seeks to accelerate fundamental research through collaboration between humans and AI.

“AI agents using crypto will become the industry’s biggest use case within the next five years,” said Sun. “As AI agents begin to transact, pay and operate autonomously, blockchain will become the financial infrastructure behind them. TRON’s focus is to provide the fast, efficient and accessible settlement layer that can support this next generation of global finance.”

TRON DAO also hosted a dedicated booth at the conference, giving attendees the opportunity to connect with the broader TRON community and learn about the ecosystem’s work across stablecoin payments, decentralized applications and AI-driven financial infrastructure. Beyond the conference floor, TRON DAO also hosted a Creators and Media Networking Happy Hour, welcoming industry leaders for an evening of light bites and conversation.

Across both events, the discussions underscored TRON’s focus on building blockchain infrastructure for a rapidly evolving financial system being shaped by stablecoins, tokenized assets, AI agents and increasingly resilient digital-asset networks.

About TRON DAO

TRON DAO is a community-governed DAO dedicated to accelerating the decentralization of the internet via blockchain technology and dApps.

Founded in September 2017, the TRON blockchain has experienced significant growth since its MainNet launch in May 2018. Today, TRON hosts the largest circulating supply of USD Tether (USDT) stablecoin, which currently exceeds $94 billion. As of October 2026, the TRON blockchain has recorded over 407 million in total user accounts, more than 15 billion in total transactions, and over $28 billion in total value locked (TVL), based on TRONSCAN. Recognized as the global settlement layer for stablecoin transactions and everyday purchases with proven success, TRON is “Moving Trillions, Empowering Billions.”
